title: Disabling Template with NONE
description: Use [Template] NONE to create a regular test case when Test Template is defined in Settings.

story.setup: MENTOR-9: "What if you have a suite-level Test Template, but ONE test needs to be different—not templated? Use [Template] NONE to override."
story.context: Sometimes you need a mix: mostly templated tests, but a few regular tests. NONE lets you opt out of the suite template for specific tests.
story.success: MENTOR-9: "Good! The first two tests used the suite template, but the third test used [Template] NONE and ran normally. Flexibility when you need it."

theory.title: Exercise 2.3.5: Disabling Templates with NONE
theory.content:
MENTOR-9: "Templates are powerful, but sometimes you need an exception. Maybe one test does setup, or cleanup, or something unique. Use [Template] NONE to opt out of the suite template for that specific test."

[Template] NONE

Use NONE to disable suite-level Test Template for specific tests:

*** Settings ***
Test Template    Validate Data

*** Test Cases ***
Test 1
    data1    expected1
    data2    expected2

Test 2
    data3    expected3

Special Setup Test
    [Template]    NONE
    Log    Running special setup
    ${config}=    Set Variable    Custom
    Log    Setup complete: ${config}

When to Use NONE:

  • Suite setup/teardown style tests
  • One-off validation that doesn't fit template
  • Logging or reporting tests
  • Mix templated and non-templated in same file

Example: Mixed Test Suite

*** Settings ***
Test Template    Should Be Greater Than

*** Test Cases ***
Performance Tests
    ${response_time_1}    ${0.5}
    ${response_time_2}    ${0.5}
    ${response_time_3}    ${0.5}

Load Tests
    ${concurrent_users}    ${100}
    ${requests_per_sec}    ${50}

Test Cleanup
    [Template]    NONE
    Log    All performance tests complete
    ${total_tests}=    Set Variable    5
    Log    Total tests run: ${total_tests}
    Log    Cleanup successful

First two tests are templated (Should Be Greater Than), third test is regular (cleanup).

⚠️ Template NONE Tips

  • NONE must be uppercase (not none or None)
  • Only needed when Test Template exists in Settings
  • After NONE, write regular keywords (not data rows)
  • Can mix [Template] NONE and templated tests freely
  • Great for: cleanup, logging, special validations
  • Keeps suite focused but allows exceptions
